title: XML ExtractValue with XPath using last() function return wrong result

comments.text: Description: For XML document 11 with XPath Query //*[last() <= 1] MySQL returns empty result. Should return result 1 1 as BaseX, Saxon & Oracle db returns result 11 1 How to repeat: Execute statement: select ExtractValue('11','//*[last() <= 1]'); See error in output.

Hi, Actually, this functionality is fully supported, only with some minor adjustments ...... You should set your XQuery like this: select ExtractValue('11','last()' <=1); +-----------------------------------------------+ | ExtractValue('11','last()' <=1) | +-----------------------------------------------+ | 1 | +-----------------------------------------------+ You can easily amend your query to return the result that you would like to ...... These are just small variation in the syntax, all of which are within the rules ....... Not a bug.
